thread:
jen (PM): Quick sync — putting together the PRD for Embeddings V2 + structured-output for Chat. Need clear acceptance criteria, rollout gates, migration playbook, and a concise edge-case section. Sharing an initial outline: https://docs.redwood.ai/prd/embeddings-v2-draft :mag:
 tom (Eng Lead): propose we split into three scoped deliverables: 1) vector dimension migration + namespace isolation, 2) structured response templates for chat/completions + SDK contract, 3) rerank tie-break and graceful fallback policy. rollouts by phase.
 priya (ML Eng): for migration: dual-index approach (write-to-new + read-from-both) for 30d, deterministic id hashing for idempotent upserts, and background reindex. will add algorithm sketch with complexity and ops steps.
 alberto (SE): customers expect zero-downtime. include compatibility matrix (old/new dim, cosine drift), and a rollback playbook: traffic-shift commands, reindex cancel, and how to serve mixed-dim responses to clients.
 danielle (QA): initial acceptance criteria suggestions:
- migration error rate < 0.5% measured over 24h under pilot load
- search p50/p95 latency on dedicated < 35ms / 110ms
- embedding similarity drift mean < 0.015 (cosine)
- structured-output schema conformance >= 92% on canonical prompts
- privacy gate: no PII in telemetry for pilot tenants
 kai (Security): encryption notes: KMS-backed keys for embedding blobs, tenant-scoped ACLs, and ensure prefix-cache threat model documented. require privacy checklist signed before partner pilot.
 tom (Eng Lead): rollout policy (PRD snippet):
```
phase 0: dev/integration canary (internal, 5-10% traffic)
phase 1: invited pilot (1-2 customers, config locked)
phase 2: staged ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 5-7 days with automated quality checks
rollback triggers: MRR drop > 3% vs baseline, embedding drift > 0.03, error spike > 2x
```
 priya (ML Eng): rerank tie-break: when primary scores within eps=0.005, break ties deterministically using recency-weighted signal + bm25 proxy. include seeded-deterministic ordering to avoid churn between runs.
 alberto (SE): when client includes both embeddings+rerank in same call: prefer server-side shared-prefix caching; expose per-request opt-out header/flag for strict isolation. document SDK surface change (new optional param: prefer_cache=false).
 jen (PM): edge cases to call out in PRD (need short mitigation notes):
- tokenization mismatch between model variants -> mismatched vector norms
- partial upserts during reindex -> stale vectors returned to queries
- tenant id/namespace renames causing collisions in index
- structured-output + function-calling: schema changes mid-rollout -> choose fail-open for best-effort vs fail-closed for strict contract; recommend fail-closed for pilot customers
- caching + privacy: prefix-cache may leak inference patterns across requests
 danielle (QA): e2e tests to add:
- migration forward/backward with synthetic 2x traffic load
- schema fuzzing for structured outputs (missing fields, extra fields, type mismatches)
- rerank determinism: seeded monte-carlo runs and comparison against golden ordering
- service-level smoke: ensure p50/p95 and error-rate thresholds enforced in canary
 kai (Security): acceptance gate: threat model doc + risk mitigations reviewed; privacy checklist signed; KMS integration validated in staging.
 tom (Eng Lead): metrics and alerts to bake into PRD:
- daily embedding drift (cosine) and alert > 0.02
- MRR / nDCG change over rolling 24h and alert on >3% regression
- error-rate relative increase > 2x triggers rollback
- cache hit ratio and memory growth alerts
 jen (PM): action items (owners + ETA):
- tom: perf budgets, canary infra commands, and alert plumbing (ETA Mon)
- priya: migration algorithm doc, dual-index details, eps thresholds for rerank (ETA Tue)
- alberto: customer migration playbook + SDK opt-out API spec (ETA Wed)
- danielle: QA test matrix, automation tickets + sample datasets (ETA Thu)
- kai: security checklist + staging KMS runbook (ETA Thu)
 deploy-bot: PRD draft created: https://docs.redwood.ai/prd/embeddings-v2-draft (access: product, eng)
 jen (PM): everyone, thanks — I'll consolidate and push an update for review tomorrow. tagging @eng @ml for visibility :thumbsup:
